summary.statement: 2 gameplay-blocking or materially disruptive issues are included in this client report.

severityLegend.label: Blocker
severityLegend.meaning: Stops normal progression, prevents the objective, or leaves no normal in-game recovery.

severityLegend.label: Major
severityLegend.meaning: Materially breaks core gameplay, important player state, or fairness while play can still continue or recover.

issueIndex.title: Arena cannot start a second match
Match loadout drops when the player dies

issues.title: Arena cannot start a second match
issues.issue: After one match ends, the same arena cannot start again, blocking the next round for players.
reproduction: Return both players to the lobby.
Confirm the new match does not start.
issues.observed: The previous session remains active and the next match does not start.
issues.expected: The arena returns to an available state after match cleanup.
issues.recommendedResolution: Clear arena session ownership during match cleanup so the arena becomes available for the next round.

issues.title: Match loadout drops when the player dies
issues.issue: Match-owned loadout items drop into the world on death, allowing equipment to be lost or collected by other players.
reproduction: Start a match and receive the normal player loadout.
Let the player die during the active match.
Return to the death location after respawn.
Confirm the loadout items are present as world drops.
issues.observed: Loadout items appear as world drops at the death location.
issues.expected: Match-owned loadout items are restored through the intended respawn flow without becoming world drops.
issues.recommendedResolution: Prevent match-owned loadout items from entering the world-drop path and restore them through the respawn flow.
